Aggregated Captcha Images and Text
	


	
		
	
	
		Credits
	

All the images (not the texts) here contained have been downloaded and selected from various datasets on kaggle.com

	
		
	
	
		What is this?
	

This is a dataset containing some hundreds of thousands of images taken from real and used captchas (reCaptcha, hCaptcha and various others) and containing an equally big amount of random 4-8 length texts generated each one in 363 different fonts and with different random noise… See the full description on the dataset page: https://huggingface.co/datasets/tcsenpai/aggregated_captcha_images_and_text.
